tokens.note: Two-surface live inspect (plaid.com home + plaid.com/products). Primary = the deep navy #02294b that fills dark sections, input borders, and the dark-section pill CTAs. Signature ink is the dark teal #012e37 (nav/menu). Hero H1 uses a bright green→teal radial-gradient text fill (#86ef5a → #10d0b7) clipped to glyphs. Bright gradient stops live in prose/components only — never as a solid token role.
